title: Seawater Sampling for Environmental DNA Metabarcoding
author: Mary McElroy

steps.title: Prepare Sampling Bottle
steps.instruction: Attach a 1L bottle to the sampling pole while wearing gloves.

steps.title: Collect Seawater Sample
steps.instruction: Collect a seawater sample using the telescopic pole to avoid footwear contamination, ensuring sand or sediment is not stirred up in shallow areas.

substeps.instruction: Remove the cap and submerge the bottle in seawater.
Fill the bottle completely and rinse once with seawater.
Discard the rinse on the shore or sufficiently away from the collection point.
Refill the bottle and securely replace the cap, avoiding contact with interior surfaces of the bottle and cap.

steps.title: Store and Organize Samples
steps.instruction: Secure the collected sample and maintain a field blank.

substeps.instruction: Detach the bottle from the sampling pole and place it in a storage bag, bin, or cooler.
Add ice to the cooler if samples will be stored for more than 1 hour before filtration.
Keep a 1L field blank in the storage bin alongside biological samples.

steps.title: Replicate Sampling
steps.instruction: Repeat the collection process for 10x 1L bottle samples.

substeps.instruction: Spread sample collection across discrete tide pools and in the surf zone on the lower edge of the exposed rocky shore.

steps.title: Document Site Data
steps.instruction: Record the time, water level, and any relevant site conditions.
